description: This Java class handles commands related to saving collection sheet data for a group within the Fineract project. It is annotated as a Spring service and implements the handling of a specific command type, delegating the core processing to a service class.

classes.name: SaveGroupCollectionSheetCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands for saving a group's collection sheet, implementing command processing interface and delegating to the write platform service.

methods.name: SaveGroupCollectionSheetCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the CollectionSheetWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command by calling the write platform service to update the collection sheet.
